adaptation: Independent implementation of cached structure faces and a time-based model transform. Retains all real world blocks and hides only their client-side static faces while working; does not copy the Godforge world-removal/reconstruction lifecycle, shader, geometry or assets.
geometry: Existing LGPL-3.0-only SuperconductingElectromagneticStructure; interior rows 2..18, columns/depth 4..10: 148 C, 68 E, 17 H blocks. Existing texture paths and licenses remain unchanged.
rotation: 1.5 degrees per tick around the machine-local vertical axis; 240 ticks per revolution. Server-authoritative running flag and client world-time interpolation.
